title: Proper direct image preserves ambient sums of classical complexes
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and $f:X\to Y$ a proper scheme morphism. Assume $e\geq0$ bounds all fibre dimensions after every base change [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-pc-base-change] [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Work in ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves and their unbounded pro-étale derived categories, with total K-injective $Rf_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. For every small family $(K_s)_{s\in I}$ of complexes with classical cohomology, the canonical ambient coproduct comparison is invertible:
$$\bigoplus_{s\in I}Rf_*K_s\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*\bigl(\bigoplus_{s\in I}K_s\bigr).$$
Classical means [sk-def-pe-classical-definition], and the comparison is the map whose composite with the $s$-th coprojection is $Rf_*(\iota_s)$. The family may be empty; no common cohomological bound or cohomological-dimension assumption on a ground field is imposed.

proof.text: Specialize the base-change fibre bound to the identity of Y. The pullback along the identity, and its fibres, are canonically isomorphic to X and the fibres of f. Transport topological Krull dimension through the induced homeomorphism. This is the private helper fibre_bound.

proof.text: Every module over the finite ring A is additively torsion. Apply the proper torsion direct-image bound with d=e to the underlying abelian étale sheaf, obtaining vanishing above 2e. The higher-direct-image forgetful isomorphism and faithfulness of forgetting transfer this vanishing to A-module sheaves. The identification on a sheaf in degree zero gives the usual rightDerived vanishing. This is etale_cd.

They give the upper bound b+2e on each bounded truncation. The pro-étale unbounded derived adjunction makes direct image preserve countable products. Source exact countable products and DerivedCategory.isLE_obj_of_forall_isLE_obj_truncGE then give the uniform bound b+2e+1 on the original bounded-above classical complex. This is fixed_amplitude; the extra one is harmless.

proof.text: Apply the already proved source theorem DerivedCategory.isIso_sigmaComparison_of_bounded with the class DerivedCategory.etaleOriginHomology and amplitude 2e+1. Source homologyProperty_truncLE, homologyProperty_truncGE and etaleOriginHomology_sigma give the class stability hypotheses; right derived direct image preserves lower bounds. The source theorem isIso_sigmaComparison_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_bounded supplies the uniformly bounded-family case for every proper f, with no ground-field hypothesis. Its finite-window argument is exactly the truncation-and-naturality portion of the original plan, already proved in the source library. This is fixed_coproducts.

proof.text: The canonical coefficient realization is an exact equivalence. Its underlying abelian sheaf is naturally the original underlying abelian sheaf: use the sheafification counit, giving realizationToSheafIso. The derived homology comparison and invariance of classicality under isomorphism therefore show that preimages of the given family under derived realization have homology of étale origin. Use proEtaleClassicalSheavesModules for this last identification. This is classical_of_realization.

proof.text: Derive finiteCoefficientRealization_directImage using the existing source composition isomorphisms mapDerivedCategoryCompRightDerivedFunctorIso and rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso. Realization is an equivalence and thus preserves K-injectives and coproducts. Apply fixed_coproducts to the preimage family, transport colimit preservation through the derived natural isomorphism by Mathlib preservesColimit_of_natIso, cancel the realization equivalence, and transport along the family isomorphism by preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram. Thus the actual finiteCoefficientDerivedDirectImage preserves this specified family coproduct.

proof.text: Take the standard source coproduct cofan. Since its image is colimiting, use that image cofan as the target coproduct witness. The comparison in the statement is then the descent of this cofan to itself, hence the identity by uniqueness in the colimit universal property. This also proves the empty-family case.
